ValidationRule.description: Opportunity is Locked for edits once the Opportunity is closed won.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.OpportunityTrigger__c) , NSP_Lock_Opportunity__c , NOT( OR( $UserRole.DeveloperName = "NSP_L1_Support", $UserRole.DeveloperName = "NSP_L2_Support_Admin", $Profile.Name = "Sales Operations", CONTAINS( $Profile.Name , 'System Admin' ) , $Profile.Name = "Integration User", $UserRole.Name = "Sales Engineer", AND( $Profile.Name = "Marketing Channel", OR( IsChanged(NSP_Partner__c), IsChanged(NSP_SubPartner__c), IsChanged(NSP_Producer__c) ) ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Once Opportunity is Closed Won it cannot be modified. Please contact Sales Operations team
